item.title: The Radiation Exposure Lie
item.description:
📝 Since children have smaller thyroids, their effective doses were much larger. The idea that any release of radioactive material is an intolerable disaster rests on the claim that radiation is harmful even in small, spread-out doses. The studies that claim to show harms from slow, drawn-out ionizing radiation are unconvincing.

item.title: US Supreme Court rules geofence warrants require constitutional protections
item.description:
📝 Justice Elena Kagan wrote the majority opinion. Photograph: Grace Cary/Getty ImagesUS supreme court rules geofence warrants require constitutional privacy protectionsLaw enforcement’s use of warrants sweeping smartphone location data requires privacy protections, court rules US supreme court decisions – live updates The US supreme court has ruled that law enforcement’s use of sprawling warrants that sweep up smartphone location data requires privacy protections under the fourth amendment, in a boost to critics who view their use as an unconstitutional dragnet. Privacy advocates share her concerns that geofence warrants can be overly broad in the area they target, as well as the length of time they cover.
🔗 Read more: https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/29/supreme-court-geofence-warrants-case-decision
